description: For a finite admissible definition chain, every nonempty initial model has exactly one final structure preserving its original interpretations and satisfying each package in the corresponding reduct.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.tower_unique_expansion.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {K : ℕ → FirstOrder.Language}
  (d :
    (i : ℕ) →
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.towerLanguage L K i) (K i))
  (T : L.Theory) (n : ℕ)
  (hd :
    ∀ i < n,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.Admissible (d i)
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.towerTheory d T i))
  (M : Type w) [s : L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] [M ⊨ T] :
  ∃! S, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.TowerExpansion d M n S
